description: Purposeful symbolic attributes used by level-generator themes and platform selection. Atlas manifests store readable IDs; no fixed bit allocation is used.

tags.label: Terrain
tags.description: May be used as generated terrain.

tags.label: Foreground
tags.description: May be used as foreground decoration.

tags.label: Background
tags.description: May be used as background decoration.

tags.label: Platform
tags.description: Intended to be walked on. The autotagger checks authored collision geometry and visible top-surface depth.

tags.label: Door-suitable platform
tags.description: May support an entry or exit portal. Placement still has to pass footprint and blockable-polygon safety checks.

tags.label: Run-and-gun platform
tags.description: Provides a broad, nearly horizontal playable surface for combat.

tags.label: Moving platform
tags.description: Looks appropriate while moving or floating. This aesthetic attribute is always assigned manually.
